event.description: Retry the rank-5 learned tied token factorization with 75000 steps, preserving the prior 45000-step cosine trajectory and continuing at the 1e-4 learning-rate floor.
event.proposal: Family: token representation. Retained incumbent is attempt-0051 with 2944 parameters at 99.440000%, a +0.440000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: the most recent accepted result is attempt-0051, rank-6 learned tied token codes at 2944 parameters and 99.44%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0052, rank 5 under the prior 45000-step schedule, an optimization failure whose validation reached 98.30% at the endpoint; 5 prior token-representation macro attempts. Attempt-0054 was a scored nonqualification of the unchanged rank-6 incumbent under a longer schedule, so it is not evidence for rank five. Hypothesis: the direct rank-5 code/projection factorization can qualify if its continuously improving prior trajectory receives 30000 more constant-floor updates. This is a representational token-subspace compression from rank 6 to rank 5, not parameterization-preserving scalar pruning; the training continuation is an explicitly changed condition for this previously unscored architecture. It removes 29 actual parameters (2944 to 2915) while preserving the same learned expansion for input embeddings and output logits. It is more informative than the nearest untested rank-4 alternative because it first resolves the immediate one-rank boundary under sufficient optimization.
